name: Affinity with (Art)
description: The character advances the chosen Art 50% faster.

name: Puissant (Art)
description: Adds +3 to the chosen Art whenever it is used, without spending experience on it.

name: Superior Lab Equipment
description: The laboratory's equipment is unusually good, adding +3 to Lab Totals for work done in it.

name: Poor Aging
description: The character's aging rolls suffer a -3 penalty.
